answer: At first light a claimant wanders a marked trail across the tundra carrying a sealed kernel packet, plants it at an assigned plot, and photographs the planted kernel with a timestamp and a witness beside the trail log. Two tundra keepers check the photograph against the trail log and the kernel registry within six days. A copied photograph, a wrong plot, or a missing log entry voids the season, burns a 60-credit stake, and bars the sponsor for a year. One honest wanderer spends 60 credits; a thousand fakes would need a thousand tundra treks and a thousand kernel plantings.
